knownLimitations: Genre classification is a rule-based first pass over subTags plus a small artist-name override list; it was NOT derived from listening or external research.
210/673 tracks (31%) fall below the 0.72 genre-confidence threshold, concentrated in genuine genre-fusion cases (jazz-rap, neo-soul-jazz, jazz-funk, lofi-hiphop).
6 cross-videoId dedup merges are plausible but unverified without listening.
2 tracks have unresolved energy conflicts between duplicate source copies; provisional values were chosen by source order, not evidence.

Three classification bugs were found and fixed during this migration's own development (false-positive genre matches on jazz-bar/beach-house/disco-floor; location leaks into retainedTags; season/weather leaks into subGenres) -- their fixes were targeted, not exhaustively verified across the full vocabulary.
5 residual retainedTags values still contain borderline location language (highway-rush, home, bedroom-calm, club-classic, club-chic) per this report's own quality checks.
